name: travel-packing
description: Claude Code plugin: Travel Packing Assistant — work out the real baggage allowance for every segment of an international itinerary, inventory what is being carried by weight, solve the pack against the binding limit, price the excess-baggage options, and rank an emergency leave-behind list. Renders an airport counter card and a per-bag packing list to PDF with Typst. One trip workspace per itinerary.
